incident-bot: :warning: 1934002042 - Alert: elevated tail latency detected (p99) for inference-runtime in prod-west. Potential KV cache fragmentation and paging activity.

Priya Nair: ack. seeing user reports of streaming stalls + spikes in p99. pulling dashboards now.

Mike Chen: joining. any config changes or deploys recently?

Priya Nair: no config deploys in last hour. metrics: p95 ~180ms -> 270ms, p99 up to 1.1s. kv_cache.total_evictions = 520/min, kv_cache.prefill.size_avg = 14MB, kv_cache.free_chunks = 120 (down from 900). page_faults/sec = 22.

Jin Park: that free_chunks number screams fragmentation. prefill is allocating lots of variable-sized entries, not getting coalesced, causing more paging. decode threads blocked waiting on disk reads.

Laura M: CS reports 6 customers with intermittent stalls; two reported dropped streams. Ticket #INC-2034 created.

Priya Nair: immediate plan: 1) stop aggressive prefill on affected zone, 2) throttle prefill worker threads, 3) increase decode-worker count to prioritize real-time decodes, 4) consider draining high-memory hosts.

incident-bot: action: runbook-apply patch queued -> kv.prefill.enabled=false on prod-west-canaries.

Mike Chen: before flipping, can we try lowering kv.prefill.max_entries from 50k -> 8k and enable soft-eviction to free fragmented slots? less disruptive.

Priya Nair: will apply the soft change to two canaries now.

Jin Park: also bump --kv-decode-threads from 4 -> 7 on canaries. decode queue depth currently at 42.

Priya Nair: executing decode bump.

Priya Nair: canary snapshot after 90s: p99 dropped from 1100ms -> 340ms, page_faults/sec -> 5, streaming.stalls/min -> 2.

Mike Chen: looks promising. propose rolling to remaining prod-west hosts with 10s stagger. watch memory usage.

Laura M: sending interim customer note: "We are aware of degraded streaming performance in your region. Our engineers are applying mitigations; expected improvement within ~10-20 minutes. We'll follow up with root cause and any remediation."

incident-bot: severity set to SEV3 per SLA impact guidelines.

Priya Nair: rolling change to rest of prod-west. also enabling a temporary metric to count prefill allocation failures: kv.prefill.alloc_failures.

Jin Park: adding a short circuit: if kv.prefill.alloc_failures > 50 in 1m, set kv.prefill.enabled=false automatically. patching autoscaler rule.

Mike Chen: rolling finished. global p99 stabilizing at ~300-360ms. free_chunks recovering slowly to ~600. allocation failures spiked at the start then fell.

Laura M: CS confirms three customers saw improved behavior; two still reported small hiccups but overall better.

Priya Nair: captured heap and slab histograms from affected hosts for postmortem. saved to /var/log/kv-dumps/1934002042/.

Jin Park: early root cause hypothesis: a sudden influx of many long-context sessions with low prefix reuse increased prefill churn and produced fine-grained allocations, fragmenting the cache and forcing the allocator to page. Meanwhile decode workers starved because IO latency spiked during prefill garbage churn. Need long-term: smarter allocator, prefill throttling tied to decode queue and memory pressure, and compaction pass.

Mike Chen: created tickets:
- ENG-5011 analyze batch pattern that triggered prefill ramp (assigned Mike)
- ENG-5012 implement prefill backpressure based on decode queue and mem pressure (assigned Priya)
- ENG-5013 add cache compaction/defragmentation job (assigned Jin)
- ENG-5014 update runbook with automatic prefill kill-switch and traffic-shift steps (assigned Laura)

oncall-rotation-bot: handoff to next oncall @Mike Chen scheduled at 1934003600 UTC.

Priya Nair: leaving mitigation steps for followup: 
```
Mitigation checklist:
1) Reduce kv.prefill.max_entries -> 8k
2) Enable soft-eviction and soft-alloc-fallback
3) Increase --kv-decode-threads to 6-8 on hot hosts
4) Enable auto-disable: if kv.prefill.alloc_failures > 50/m -> kv.prefill.enabled=false
5) If p99 remains >800ms after 10m, shift 15% traffic to spare-region and open support tickets for impacted customers
```

Mike Chen: I'll monitor for next hour. Priya, Jin, Laura - please keep logs and dump locations in ENG-5011. We'll schedule a retro and full postmortem doc in 24-48h.

Laura M: CS will follow up with customers for more detailed timelines and offer compensatory credits if impactful. tagging @Sabrina to own comms.

Sabrina: acknowledged, coordinating messages.

incident-bot: incident mitigated at 1934003720 (auto-monitoring shows p99 < 400ms for 5 consecutive minutes). Keeping this thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
